findings.issue: The list of what the frontier veto 'never outranks' names pause, which is a workflow-level check, but leaves out the max-duration stop. In deep-review.yaml, step_check_max_duration (line 1190) runs before step_check_convergence (line 1276). When maxDurationMinutes is reached, the loop skips dispatch and goes to synthesis with maxDurationReached. That stop also beats the veto, so a reader could think an open node holds the run past its duration budget.

Same gap as L7-2.
